string.name: call_voicemail
string.comment: Action that calls the user's voicemail service.

string.name: placeholder_voicemail
string.comment: Empty-state message shown when phone permission is required to use voicemail.

resources.string: 要使用语音信箱，请开启电话权限

string.name: turn_on
string.comment: Button that opens settings to grant the permission required by the current screen.

string.name: retry
string.comment: Button that retries loading or activating visual voicemail.

string.name: visual_voicemail_unavailable
string.comment: Title shown when visual voicemail cannot be activated.

resources.string: 无法启用可视语音信箱

string.name: visual_voicemail_unavailable_description
string.comment: Explanation shown when the carrier or device does not support visual voicemail.

resources.string: 你的运营商或设备目前不支持可视语音信箱。你仍可拨打语音信箱收听留言。

string.name: visual_voicemail_no_messages
string.comment: Empty-state title shown when visual voicemail contains no messages.

string.name: visual_voicemail_no_messages_description
string.comment: Empty-state explanation shown when visual voicemail is active but contains no messages.

resources.string: 可视语音信箱已就绪。新留言会显示在这里。

string.name: unknown_caller
string.comment: Fallback sender name for voicemail from an unidentified caller.

string.name: play_voicemail
string.comment: Accessibility label for playing a voicemail message.

string.name: playing
string.comment: Accessibility state indicating that a voicemail message is playing.
